name: DeepSeek Harness for Win v1.0.0
body:
## Features

- View release notes and version history directly inside the desktop app.
- See distribution, desktop shell, and kernel component versions from the About view.

## Improvements

- Keep release notes available from the local release manifest when the network is unavailable.
- Make update decisions clearer by showing the release summary before starting the portable runtime updater.

## Bug Fixes

- Preserve desktop preferences while adding release-note state to the user configuration.
